     8	/-!
     9	# DAT-0a — the P5-uniform `H¹`-vanishing bound
    10	
    11	For the curve bundle `Y` (integral, smooth of relative dimension one, locally of finite type
    12	and quasi-compact over a field `K`) carrying a **finite dominant** morphism `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹`,
    13	there is a single integer threshold `b`, depending only on `(Y, π)` and quantified over **all**
    14	Weil divisors `D`, past which the degree-one cohomology of `𝒪(D)` vanishes:
    15	
    16	`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1`:
    17	`∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D, b ≤ deg D → Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(D))`.
    18	
    19	This is the **P5-uniform** pre-brick of the Wave-4 datum campaign (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md`
    20	§2.1, §4 DAT-0a). It is consumed by DAT-D's uniform Grassmannian twist, where the twist exponent
    21	`M` is chosen so that `deg (Θ^M) ≥ b` and the whole degree-`g` family lands in the vanishing
    22	locus.
    23	
    24	## The route (worksheet §4 DAT-0a, collapsed form)
    25	
    26	The proof is the FLV-class argument (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean`) with the twist specialized to the
    27	fiber divisor `F = fiberWeilDivisor π` and the base twist fixed at the FLV-fiber threshold `n₁` of
    28	`D₀ = 0`:
    29	
    30	* FLV-fiber at `D₀ = 0` (`subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isFinite_toP1`) gives `n₁` with
    31	  `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n·F))` for all `n ≥ n₁`; take `n = n₁`, so the base twist `n₁·F` is fixed;
    32	* `0 < deg F` (`zero_lt_deg_fiberWeilDivisor`) makes `b := n₁·deg F + 1 − χ(𝒪_Y)` a legal
    33	  threshold: for `deg D ≥ b` the residual class `[D]·[F]^{-n₁}` has degree `≥ 1 − χ`, so
    34	  `exists_effective_of_picClass` yields an **effective** witness `E` of that class;
    35	* `n₁·F + E` is in the class of `D`; `peel_effective` transports `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n₁·F))` to
    36	  `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n₁·F + E))`, and witness-independence
    37	  (`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq`, W6-lite) upgrades it to `𝒪(D)`.
    38	
    39	Because `n₁` (hence the base twist) is fixed, the effective witness carries the whole degree slack,
    40	and `b` depends only on `(Y, π)` — exactly the shape DAT-D consumes.
    41	-/
    42	
    43	set_option autoImplicit false
    44	
    45	universe u
    46	
    47	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    48	
    49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    50	
    51	open Scheme
    52	
    53	section Uniform
    54	
    55	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    56	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    57	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    58	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    59	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    60	
    61	/-- **DAT-0a — the P5-uniform `H¹`-vanishing bound.** For a **finite** dominant `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹`
    62	compatible with the structure morphisms, there is a single threshold `b : ℤ`, depending only on
    63	`(Y, π)`, past which the degree-one cohomology of `𝒪(D)` vanishes for **every** Weil divisor `D` of
    64	degree `≥ b`:
    65	
    66	`∃ b, ∀ D, b ≤ deg D → Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(D))`.
    67	
    68	The bound is `b = n₁·deg F + 1 − χ(𝒪_Y)`, with `F = fiberWeilDivisor π` and `n₁` the FLV-fiber
    69	threshold at `D₀ = 0`; see the module docstring for the collapsed route
    70	(`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §4 DAT-0a). Consumed by DAT-D's uniform Grassmannian twist. -/
    71	theorem exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1
    72	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    73	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    74	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    75	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    76	    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D : Y.CurveDivisor, b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K D →
    77	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K D) 1) := by
    78	  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ :=
    79	    subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isFinite_toP1 π hπ (0 : Y.CurveDivisor)
    80	  have hd'pos : 0 < CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) :=
    81	    zero_lt_deg_fiberWeilDivisor π
    82	  refine ⟨(n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) + 1
    83	      - Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K), fun D hD => ?_⟩
    84	  -- the residual class `[D] · [F]^{-n₁}`
    85	  set c : Y.CechPic := CurveDivisor.picClass K D
    86	    * (CurveDivisor.picClass K (fiberWeilDivisor π) ^ n₁)⁻¹ with hc
    87	  have hcdeg : classDeg K c
    88	      = CurveDivisor.deg K D - (n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) := by
    89	    rw [hc, classDeg_mul, classDeg_inv, classDeg_pow, classDeg_picClass, classDeg_picClass]
    90	    ring
    91	  -- an effective witness of the residual class
    92	  obtain ⟨W, hWc⟩ := CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq K c
    93	  have hWdeg : 1 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
    94	    have hWeq : CurveDivisor.deg K W
    95	        = CurveDivisor.deg K D - (n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) := by
    96	      rw [← hcdeg, ← hWc, classDeg_picClass]
    97	    linarith
    98	  obtain ⟨E, hEnonneg, hEc⟩ := exists_effective_of_picClass W hWdeg
    99	  -- the witness divisor `n₁ • F + E` is in the class of `D`
   100	  have hclass : CurveDivisor.picClass K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π + E)
   101	      = CurveDivisor.picClass K D := by
   102	    rw [CurveDivisor.picClass_add, picClass_nsmul, hEc, hWc, hc,
   103	      mul_comm (CurveDivisor.picClass K D), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
   104	  -- base vanishing at `n₁ • F`, peel `E`, transport along the class
   105	  have hbase : Subsingleton
   106	      (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π)) 1) := by
   107	    have h := hn₁ n₁ le_rfl
   108	    rwa [zero_add] at h
   109	  have hpeel : Subsingleton
   110	      (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π + E)) 1) :=
   111	    peel_effective (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π) E hEnonneg hbase
   112	  exact subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq K hclass hpeel
   113	
   114	end Uniform
   115	
   116	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# DD-0 — the section bound `h⁰(𝒪(A)) ≤ max 0 (deg A + 1)`
    10	
    11	The section-bound half of the DAT-D brick DD-0 (`informal/dat-d-worksheet.md` §5 DD-0,
    12	consumed by the P-fib normalization step F1 of §3.3): on the curve bundle `X` (integral,
    13	smooth of relative dimension one, quasi-compact over a field `K`, with finite `H⁰`/`H¹`
    14	of `𝒪_X`), the global-section count of any divisor sheaf is bounded by its degree,
    15	
    16	`h⁰(𝒪(A)) ≤ max 0 (deg A + h⁰(𝒪_X))`,
    17	
    18	hence `≤ max 0 (deg A + 1)` when `h⁰(𝒪_X) = 1` (the geometrically-integral curve value,
    19	`ChiCurve.h0_moduleKSheaf`; kept as an explicit hypothesis here so the ledger layer stays
    20	on the abstract bundle).
    21	
    22	## Route (worksheet §5 DD-0: "peeling on the landed slice SES; base case via
    23	effective-witness degree ≥ 0")
    24	
    25	* **`h¹` never drops under effective twists** (`h1_add_single_le` →
    26	  `h1_add_effective_le`): the dévissage SES `0 → 𝒪(D − x) → 𝒪(D) → sky → 0` has
    27	  skyscraper cokernel with no `H¹`, so the slice machinery
    28	  (`Sheaf.HModule.surjective_map_f`, `ChiSlice.lean`) gives a surjection
    29	  `H¹(𝒪(D − x)) ↠ H¹(𝒪(D))`; peel point by point exactly as `peel_effective`
    30	  (`FLVClass.lean`). In particular `h¹(𝒪(E)) ≤ h¹(𝒪_X)` for `E ≥ 0`
    31	  (`h1_le_of_effective`).
    32	* **The effective witness** (`exists_effective_of_h0_pos`): a nonzero global section of
    33	  `𝒪(A)` is a rational function `g` with `A + div g ≥ 0`, an *effective* divisor of the
    34	  same class — the extraction of `exists_effective_of_picClass` run from `0 < h⁰`
    35	  directly (no Riemann inequality needed). This is the base case: `0 < h⁰ ⟹ deg A ≥ 0`.
    36	* **Assembly** (`h0_le_deg_add_h0_of_pos`, keystone `h0_divisorSheaf_le_max`): if
    37	  `h⁰(𝒪(A)) > 0`, replace `A` by the effective witness `E` (class-invariance of `h⁰` and
    38	  `deg`, `ClassCohomology`/`Degree`), then the χ-ledger `chi_divisorSheaf` reads
    39	  `h⁰(𝒪(E)) = χ(𝒪_X) + deg E + h¹(𝒪(E)) ≤ deg A + h⁰(𝒪_X)`.
    40	
    41	The `h¹`-monotonicity lemmas are exported (not private): F1's window comparisons reuse
    42	them, and they are the natural `H¹`-side companion of `peel_effective`.
    43	-/

    45	set_option autoImplicit false
    46	
    47	universe u
    48	
    49	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    50	
    51	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    52	
    53	open Scheme
    54	
    55	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    57	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    58	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    59	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    60	
    61	/-! ## `h¹` never drops under effective twists -/
    62	
    63	/-- **The `h¹` dévissage step**: enlarging the divisor by a closed point can only shrink
    64	`h¹`: `h¹(𝒪(D)) ≤ h¹(𝒪(D − x))`. The dévissage SES `0 → 𝒪(D − x) → 𝒪(D) → sky → 0` has
    65	skyscraper cokernel with vanishing `H¹`, so the slice surjection
    66	`Sheaf.HModule.surjective_map_f` maps `H¹(𝒪(D − x))` onto `H¹(𝒪(D))`. -/
    67	theorem h1_le_h1_sub_single {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
    68	    Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K D)
    69	      ≤ Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (D - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) := by
    70	  haveI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₃ 1) :=
    71	    skyModule_subsingleton_hModule_one x (jumpModule K hx D)
    72	  haveI : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₁ 1) :=
    73	    moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_one K (devissageDivisor hx D)
    74	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Sheaf.HModule.map (devissageSES K hx D).f 1) :=
    75	    Sheaf.HModule.surjective_map_f (devissageSES_shortExact K hx D) 1
    76	  have hle : Sheaf.h1 (devissageSES K hx D).X₂ ≤ Sheaf.h1 (devissageSES K hx D).X₁ :=
    77	    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective hsurj
    78	  have hX₁ : Sheaf.h1 (devissageSES K hx D).X₁
    79	      = Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (D - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) := by
    80	    have h : Sheaf.h1 (devissageSES K hx D).X₁
    81	        = Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (devissageDivisor hx D)) := rfl
    82	    rw [h, devissageDivisor_eq_sub hx D]
    83	  have hX₂ : Sheaf.h1 (devissageSES K hx D).X₂ = Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K D) := rfl
    84	  rw [← hX₂, ← hX₁]

    86	
    87	/-- **Peeling one point on `h¹`**: `h¹(𝒪(B + x)) ≤ h¹(𝒪(B))` — the additive form of the
    88	dévissage step. -/
    89	theorem h1_add_single_le {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (B : X.CurveDivisor) :
    90	    Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (B + CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
    91	      ≤ Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K B) := by
    92	  have h := h1_le_h1_sub_single K hx (B + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
    93	  have heq : B + CurveDivisor.single hx 1 - CurveDivisor.single hx 1 = B := by abel
    94	  rwa [heq] at h
    95	
    96	/-- **Peeling a multiple of a point on `h¹`**: `h¹(𝒪(A + n·x)) ≤ h¹(𝒪(A))` — iterating
    97	`h1_add_single_le`. -/
    98	theorem h1_add_nsmul_single_le {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (A : X.CurveDivisor)
    99	    (n : ℕ) :
   100	    Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (A + n • CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
   101	      ≤ Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K A) := by
   102	  induction n with
   103	  | zero => simp
   104	  | succ n ih =>
   105	    have hstep := h1_add_single_le K hx (A + n • CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   106	    have heq : A + n • CurveDivisor.single hx 1 + CurveDivisor.single hx 1
   107	        = A + (n + 1) • CurveDivisor.single hx 1 := by
   108	      rw [succ_nsmul]; abel
   109	    rw [heq] at hstep
   110	    exact le_trans hstep ih
   111	
   112	/-- **Effective peeling on `h¹`**: `h¹(𝒪(A + E)) ≤ h¹(𝒪(A))` for any effective `E` —
   113	peel the finitely many points of `E` one multiplicity-block at a time, by induction on
   114	the size of the support (the `peel_effective` skeleton, `FLVClass.lean`). -/
   115	theorem h1_add_effective_le (A E : X.CurveDivisor) (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
   116	    Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (A + E)) ≤ Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K A) := by
   117	  suffices H : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : X.CurveDivisor), 0 ≤ E →
   118	      (toFinsupp E).support.card = n →
   119	      Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K (A + E)) ≤ Sheaf.h1 (X.divisorSheaf K A) from
   120	    H _ E hE rfl
   121	  intro n
   122	  induction n with
   123	  | zero =>
   124	    intro E hE hc
   125	    have hE0 : E = 0 :=
   126	      Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp (Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc)
   127	    rw [hE0, add_zero]
   128	  | succ n ih =>
   129	    intro E hE hc
   130	    classical
   131	    have hne : (toFinsupp E).support.Nonempty := by
   132	      rw [← Finset.card_pos, hc]; exact Nat.succ_pos n
   133	    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
   134	    set b : ℤ := toFinsupp E p with hb
   135	    have hb_nonneg : 0 ≤ b := Finsupp.le_def.mp hE p
   136	    have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb_nonneg (Ne.symm (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp))
   137	    set E' : X.CurveDivisor := Finsupp.erase p (toFinsupp E) with hE'
   138	    have hdecomp : CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + E' = E := by
   139	      rw [hE', hb]
   140	      exact Finsupp.single_add_erase p (toFinsupp E)
   141	    have hE'nonneg : 0 ≤ E' := by
   142	      rw [hE']
   143	      refine Finsupp.le_def.mpr (fun q => ?_)
   144	      by_cases hq : q = p
   145	      · subst hq; rw [Finsupp.erase_same]; rfl
   146	      · rw [Finsupp.erase_ne hq]; exact Finsupp.le_def.mp hE q
   147	    have hcard : (toFinsupp E').support.card = n := by
   148	      have hEF : toFinsupp E' = Finsupp.erase p (toFinsupp E) := rfl
   149	      rw [hEF, Finsupp.support_erase, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hp, hc, Nat.succ_sub_one]
   150	    have hsingle : CurveDivisor.single p.2 b = b.toNat • CurveDivisor.single p.2 1 := by
   151	      rw [CurveDivisor.nsmul_single_one, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb_nonneg]
   152	    have hsplit : A + E = (A + E') + b.toNat • CurveDivisor.single p.2 1 := by
   153	      rw [← hdecomp, ← hsingle]; abel
   154	    rw [hsplit]

     9	# From the order-cone to a degree threshold: single-field bounded vanishing
    10	
    11	`Ledger/SectionDrop.lean` proved that `H¹` vanishing is upward closed **in the divisor order**
    12	(`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_le`) and reduced degree-threshold vanishing to a named
    13	hypothesis `exists_bound_of_cofinal_vanishing`: *every divisor of large degree dominates some
    14	divisor at which `H¹` vanishes*.  Its docstring called that cofinality statement open, and
    15	recorded that "nothing in AJC or AJCR currently produces it".
    16	
    17	**That was wrong, and this file discharges it.**  The missing move is not a new cofinality
    18	input: it is that the peel may be applied to a *linearly equivalent translate* of the base
    19	divisor.  `Ledger/MulEquiv.lean` already supplies the translation
    20	(`mulEquivDivisorSheaf : 𝒪(A) ≅ 𝒪(A − div g)`) and `Ledger/ChiLedger.lean` already supplies
    21	the Riemann inequality that manufactures the translating function.  Both were in the tree
    22	before this file; what was missing was to put them together.
    23	
    24	## The argument, in one paragraph
    25	
    26	Fix any `D₀` with `H¹(𝒪(D₀)) = 0`.  Let `D` be a divisor with
    27	`deg D ≥ deg D₀ + 1 − χ(𝒪_X)`.  Then `deg (D − D₀) + χ(𝒪_X) ≥ 1`, so the Riemann inequality
    28	`riemann_inequality` gives `h⁰(𝒪(D − D₀)) ≥ 1`: there is a **nonzero global section** of
    29	`𝒪(D − D₀)`, i.e. a `g ∈ K(X)ˣ` with `D − D₀ + div g ≥ 0`.  Set `D₀' := D₀ − div g`.  Then
    30	`D₀' ≤ D` by construction, and `H¹(𝒪(D₀')) = 0` because `𝒪(D₀) ≅ 𝒪(D₀ − div g)`.  Apply the
    31	order-cone peel to `D₀' ≤ D`.  Done — and note this is *exactly* the cofinality statement
    32	`exists_bound_of_cofinal_vanishing` asks for, now proved rather than assumed.
